profile.description: Active Sept. 12, 2026 gravel race plus free community Biketoberfest with family activities and a kids race. Organizer liked the concept but said the event budget is tight.

notes.subject: 2026 budget objection - event remains active and family-oriented
notes.body: Nicki Simon replied Aug. 18, 2026 that Adventure Zone sounded very fun but the budget was pretty tight. Current official event information confirms WYO-131/Biketoberfest is active Sept. 12, 2026 with a free community celebration, a kids race, music, food, games and activities. Treat this as a budget objection, not a permanent rejection. If revisited, first decide whether pay-for-play or a smaller commercial structure could reasonably fit rather than repeating a prepaid quote.

followUps.label: Review 2027 WYO-131 Biketoberfest fit
followUps.reason: 2026 was a budget decline, while the community festival remains family-friendly. Check the next event's budget/footprint and whether pay-for-play is realistic before contacting Nicki again.
